name: switchboard
description: Picks the model for each subagent that names none, with OpenAI's Decisions API or Jev, from its short label only. One line per spawn above the prompt; /route shows each pick and what each subagent cost.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto (default) runs each subagent on the picked model. suggest only shows the pick.

picker.title: Picker
picker.description: Who picks a model for a subagent that names none. off (default) picks nothing and only tracks cost. openai asks OpenAI's Decisions API; jev asks TypeSafe's Jev. Only the subagent's type and short label are sent, never its task text.

models.title: Models
models.description: The models a picker may choose between, cheapest first.

style.title: Style
style.description: saver (default) picks the cheapest model that will do the job well. quality pays for the better model on anything you will rely on: audits, extra reviews, planning, new features.

respectNamed.title: Keep a named model
respectNamed.description: When the subagent call names a model, keep it and don't ask the picker. On by default.

jevApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
jevApiKey.description: For picker jev, called at api.typesafe.ai. A key in /config wins over the environment: this one, then the gateway key below, then TYPESAFE_API_KEY, then AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY.

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway key
gatewayApiKey.description: For picker jev: Jev through Vercel AI Gateway, served by TypeSafe only. Needs paid gateway credit. Empty uses AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY when no TypeSafe key is set.

gatewayZeroRetention.title: Gateway zero data retention
gatewayZeroRetention.description: Ask the gateway for zero data retention. Pro and Enterprise plans only: on Hobby every pick is refused and the rules decide.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: For picker openai. Empty uses OPENAI_API_KEY.
